mapper.sql: USER_ID as "userId", PREF_TYPE_CD as "type", PREF_KEY as "key", PREF_VAL as "value", REG_USER_ID as "regUserId", REG_DTTM as "regDttm", MOD_USER_ID as "modUserId", MOD_DTTM as "modDttm"
mapper.select: SELECT FROM TB_SY_USER_PREF WHERE USER_ID=#{userId} ORDER BY PREF_TYPE_CD,PREF_KEY
SELECT FROM TB_SY_USER_PREF WHERE USER_ID=#{userId} AND PREF_TYPE_CD=#{type} AND PREF_KEY=#{key} FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE TB_SY_USER_PREF SET PREF_VAL=#{value}, MOD_USER_ID=#{id.userId}, MOD_DTTM=clock_timestamp() WHERE USER_ID=#{id.userId} AND PREF_TYPE_CD=#{id.type} AND PREF_KEY=#{id.key}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM TB_SY_USER_PREF WHERE USER_ID=#{userId} AND PREF_TYPE_CD=#{type} AND PREF_KEY=#{key}
